title: Dashboard Design Preference Memory
purpose: Capture user-approved and user-rejected design patterns so future dashboard work starts closer to the desired taste.

globalPreferences.preference: Do not call a dashboard complete just because it is technically compliant; it must look like a modern product surface.
Avoid large repeated banners on every page. Keep command context compact unless it is the main command-center surface.
Tables should sit inside a coherent card/surface, use tabs for related tables, and paginate at 10/25/50 when row counts exceed the threshold.
Long helper text should move into a help icon/tooltip pattern instead of sitting as visible paragraph clutter.
Charts must use real modern chart components with axes, labels, tooltips, states, and comparison controls where relevant.
Every product should have one shell, one sidebar, one header model, and no standalone app embedded inside another app.

approvedReferences.note: Live Command was preferred as a stronger working cockpit direction than older static pages.

rejectedPatterns.reason: Technically aligned but still visually generic; sidebar and spacing do not yet feel like the standard.
